optimization.method: multistart exact coordinate exchange; categorical-price MNL local D-optimality at zero priors; opt-out and condition interactions included

assumptions: Zero priors are not participant estimates. Price optimized categorically to retain all three levels.
Four advertising groups and both blocks assumed balanced, independent 50:50 display swaps.
Dominance is conditional on both signs for origin, weakly preferred information, and negative price; no factual safety/environment claim.
MNL Fisher efficiency is not a mixed-logit optimality certificate or sample-size/power proof.
